n0001.title: The signs are not addressed to us
n0001.gist: Roadside boards written as commands to the machines that read them, and what happens when a program cannot tell a sign from its own operator.
n0001.sourceHeading: The signs are not addressed to us

n0002.title: The first board
n0002.gist: A sign addressed to nobody in the car, and why the sentence keeps its shape wherever it is copied.

n0003.title: The second board
n0003.gist: A sign that asks for a fence to be moved rather than for anything unusual to be drawn.
